id.description: Module ID, e.g. 'cosmology'. Must equal the directory name.

status.description: Module maturity. 'active' requires at least one approved record and registered reviewers.

owners.description: Registered maintainer/reviewer IDs from registries/reviewers. Empty blocks publication of module content (draft-only).

depends_on.description: Module-level prerequisite dependencies. Must form a DAG at build level (validated by registry).

taxonomy_provider.description: External taxonomy reference (Unified Astronomy Thesaurus, pinned version recorded in registries/taxonomy).

planned.description: True for documented proposals that exist only in the coverage map.
